ownership.TC: tests/ifpmic_api/test_auth.py and synthetic provider helpers; separate authored tests and case ledger

factory.signature: create_app(settings, *, db_factory=None, oidc_transport=None, bridge_runner=None, filesystem=None, clock=None, fault_hook=None)
factory.db_factory: Callable returning fresh psycopg connection/context manager; runtime role only, no connection on import. Default approved DSN connect_timeout10/autocommitTrue. Tests use real isolated PG18.1.
factory.oidc_transport: Optional factory returning a fresh HTTPX2 AsyncBaseTransport for one callback client; production uses fresh AsyncHTTPTransport with trust_env=False/verify=True/proxy=None/retries0. Not HTTP input.
factory.clock: Callable returning aware UTC datetime; production datetime.now(timezone.utc). Used for DB and Authlib validate(now=timestamp,leeway=0).
factory.fault_hook: Optional test-only callable(point) at session_before_commit/session_after_commit; no env/HTTP switch.

settings_policy.mode: Only mock or real. Invalid/missing required settings fail closed SETTINGS_INVALID; no real-to-mock fallback.
settings_policy.urls: All configured absolute URLs forbid userinfo/query/fragment/control characters. Authorization/token/JWKS may use different explicitly configured HTTPS origins; the exact configured method+full endpoint URL allowlist controls network access. No discovery, token jku/x5u URL lookup or provider metadata override. redirect_uri exactly api_origin + /auth/callback. post_login_url fixed and origin in allowed_ui_origins. UI/API origins canonical exact origins, not wildcard. Issuer string remains exact for JWT validation, independent of endpoint origins.
settings_policy.transport: Real URLs HTTPS only. Mock HTTP permitted only for literal loopback127.0.0.1 or ::1; all mock configured API/UI/IdP origins loopback. No production TLS/SSO acceptance inferred from mock.
settings_policy.client_auth: Only client_secret_basic with nonempty secret or explicitly configured none with PKCE; no client secret from a request.
settings_policy.crypto: csrf_key at least32 bytes. Allowed algorithms configurable nonempty unique subset of RS256/384/512,PS256/384/512,ES256/384/512; no HS/none. Default RS256.
settings_policy.launch: python -m services.ifpmic_api.serve reads IFPMIC_API_CONFIG path to explicit owner-only regular no-symlink JSON config (mode0600), csrf_key canonical base64url decoded. IFPMIC_API_PORT nonsecret validated1..65535. Bind127.0.0.1, Uvicorn access_log=False, proxy_headers=False, server_header=False; no secrets in argv, no existing AX/auth config read.

oidc.authorize: GET /auth/login takes no query. Generate independent random32-byte canonical base64url state/browser/nonce/verifier. Authlib direct AsyncOAuth2Client configured code_challenge_method=S256 creates configured authorization URL with response_type=code,scope=openid,state,nonce,redirect_uri,client_id,code_verifier. Never use Starlette PKCE-debug helper. Return303 fixed IdP URL; no user return URL.
oidc.browser_binding: ax_login cookie=random32-byte base64url, host-only,Path=/auth,HttpOnly,SameSite=Lax,Secure iff real,Max-Age300. New login rotates it; DB stores state_hash=SHA256(ASCII(state)),browser_hash=SHA256(ASCII(cookie)),nonce,pkce_verifier,expires_at=now+300seconds.
oidc.callback: GET /auth/callback allows code,state,error,error_description,iss,session_state only; duplicate parameter names, bad percent encoding/UTF8, literal controls, query>8192bytes or code>4096characters fail401 AUTH_REQUIRED without echo. State/browser canonical32-byte base64url. On matching unconsumed browser/state and expires_at>now, UPDATE consumed_at atomically and commit before exchange. Cross-browser mismatch does not consume another browser state. Once consumed, failed provider/token attempts require fresh login. Optional response iss must equal configured issuer. Provider error returns401 fixed DTO; never redirect its error_description.
oidc.network: One client handles tokenPOST and configuredJWKSGET, trust_envFalse,follow_redirectsFalse,max_redirects0,proxyNone,TLSverifyTrue,timeout5s per network operation and outer10s callback network budget. Endpoint allowlist compares exact configured method+URL, not URL from received JWT. Request Accept-Encoding:identity; reject any nonidentity Content-Encoding rather than unbounded decompression. Stream byte cap65536 per response including chunked; Content-Length is not sole enforcement. Redirect/non2xx network failure503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE; OAuth invalid_grant400/401 ->401 AUTH_REQUIRED.
oidc.verification: joserfc signature decode using KeySet.import_key_set and strict JWSRegistry(app algorithms), then Authlib CodeIDToken(claims,header,options,params). Explicit options iss=value configured issuer and aud=value client_id; params nonce,client_id and ephemeral access_token for at_hash when present. Validate(now=injected timestamp,leeway=0). Require iss/sub/aud/exp/iat and nonce; sub nonempty Unicode scalar, no NUL. aud string or nonempty unique string list contains configured client_id. Multi-audience requires azp=client_id; any supplied azp must equal client_id. NumericDate exp/iat/optionalnbf finite numeric nonbool; exp>now,nbf<=now,iat<=now. No token-claimed nonce bypass. JWKS<=32 keys, public asymmetric keys only; never token-selected key URL. Fetch per callback, no cache fallback.
oidc.identity: users.identity_subject is json.dumps([issuer,subject],ensure_ascii=True,separators=(comma,colon)), exact ordered pair, no email/display-name merge. display_name initially fixed IFPMIC user. Signed subject is only identity source.
oidc.success: One transaction upsert user, revoke existing canonical ax_session if present, insert new opaque sessionhash then commit. Only after commit set session cookie and return303 post_login_url with no query/token/state. Delete ax_login. No OAuth token persists in DB/browser/localStorage/DTO/log. Auth session commit ambiguity returns fixed503; no successful response/cookie on failed commit.

session.cookie: ax_session=random32 bytes canonical base64url without padding (43chars); host-only,Path=/,HttpOnly,SameSite=Lax,Secure iff real,Max-Age28800. Store SHA256(ASCII(cookie)), not decoded bytes.
session.validity: Require nonrevoked row with expires_at>now and last_seen_at>now-1800seconds, where created_at<=now. Expiry exactly boundary invalid. SELECT FOR UPDATE plus last_seen update in same transaction. Absolute expiry now+28800seconds never extends. Login rotation revokes old token and changes CSRF.
session.csrf: GET /api/v1/session exact {user_id,csrf_token,mode},Cache-Control:no-store. Stable token base64url_no_padding(HMAC-SHA256(csrf_key,b"ifpmic.csrf.v1\x00"+ASCII(ax_session))) = exactly43 URL-safe characters for SHA256 digest, no equals padding. The domain separator is one actual NUL byte. No rotation on GET; same key survives service restart. No CSRF or raw session token stored in DB.
session.logout: POST /auth/logout empty body only; valid current session+single matching X-CSRF-Token+exact allowed Origin. Revoke that row, commit, delete ax_session, return204. Missing/expired/revoked session401 AUTH_REQUIRED; bad CSRF403 CSRF_INVALID; bad/missing Origin403 ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN.
session.future_G4: Shared auth helper accepts caller connection/request and checks/touches session in caller transaction for write, so G4 authorization and acceptance can serialize with logout. G3 does not implement user job endpoints.

http_boundary.headers: Duplicate Origin ->403 ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN; duplicate X-CSRF-Token ->403 CSRF_INVALID; duplicate Authorization or Cookie headers, duplicate ax_session/ax_login cookie names, malformed auth cookie ->401 AUTH_REQUIRED. Single Authorization/owner_id/companyId/userId/local-board/worker headers never authenticate or override cookie actor.
http_boundary.host: Exact API-origin Host, one header, no forwarded-header trust. Invalid host ->422 INVALID_REQUEST.
http_boundary.cors: Explicit exact origins, credentials true, Vary Origin; no wildcard. GET without Origin allowed; any supplied unknown Origin forbidden403. Valid preflight: methods GET/POST, headers Content-Type/X-CSRF-Token/Idempotency-Key, Max-Age600,204; invalid preflight method/header403 FORBIDDEN. No auth required for valid preflight.
http_boundary.errors: Fixed {code,message,trace_id} JSON with message=code and server UUID trace_id. No FastAPI validation/error detail or exception repr. Headers Cache-Control:no-store,Referrer-Policy:no-referrer. JSON ensure_ascii=True. No docs/openapi routes enabled in G3 service.
http_boundary.logging: No query/request/header/body logging or debug tracing callbacks. Authlib direct flow avoids PKCE debug helper; HTTPX2 only uses fixed query-free endpoint URLs, no logging middleware. Outer application boundary suppresses unexpected raw exceptions into fixed dependency errors. Service actual stdout/stderr/captured application logs tested for callback code/state/error_description canaries. Reverse proxy log redaction remains unaccepted environment work.

verification.purpose: Prove only valid browser-bound OIDC establishes opaque sessions and authenticated CSRF writes without private query/token leakage.
verification.target: Settings/HTTPX2 transport/Authlib verification/PostgreSQL state+users+sessions/FastAPI middleware/routes/Uvicorn entrypoint.
verification.method: TC actual local signed OIDC protocol provider and real PG, two clients, literal crypto/HMAC oracles and clock boundaries, malformed/redirect/proxy/network/duplicate/rotation/concurrency/fault cases, actual service logging probe; main frozen regression gate after targeted pass.
verification.agent: Independent TC author; main product integration; separate contract and final evidence reviewers.
verification.pass_criteria: All authored normal/exception/boundary/regression cases pass, no skips; issuer/subject only identity, one-time state, strict token verification, only valid Origin+CSRF+current session logout, sensitive output0; private PG/server terminate cleanly.
verification.expected_result: Locally verified G3 auth foundation; no corporate SSO or original AT-21 completion claim.
verification.evidence: Source-pinned contract reviews, TC ledger and private retained first-failure logs, frozen JUnit/TAP+gate with source before/after hashes, sanitized cookie/HTTP/crypto/service-log canary assertions and lifecycle hashes.
verification.failure_recovery: Preserve first failing output and exact source; diagnose product vs fixture vs oracle. Return to affected auth/transport/session boundary and rerun all G3 plus relevant G1/G2 before final acceptance. Material parent-plan semantics changes require reapproval.
verification.regression_scope: Frozen G3 gate includes all Python G1/G2/G3 and existing B01Node48, environment/hash lock and original17+2/96protected byte checks. Full Node387/build/browser/API/workspace acceptance stays G6; no claim of satisfying G6 UI omission conditions at G3.
